notes: Tracker update date is not a common reporting cutoff for all source records.
Follow-up dates count Monday–Friday only; check office holidays before sending.
No automatic emails are scheduled. Background acquisition is paused for owner review; the 9 October active research does not resume it.
One panchayat sample assessed: Chandanbhati. Two local work references found; exact geography and official activity mapping remain unverified.
Funding Atlas covers Union funding separately from contractor payments. Interface completion and complete programme/year evidence coverage are separate gates.

The owner narrowed active collection to FY 2025–26 and FY 2026–27 to source cutoff, in the 28-state order. Prior holdings are preserved. Complete payment cards are not a prerequisite for collecting useful separate facts.

12 October: first source pass assessed all 28 states. Budgets, recorded expenditure, project cost, award values, source progress and tender notices remain distinct; no new financial facts were publicly approved.
Assam public active-tender register requires CAPTCHA; current homepage rows are only a sample. Public finance exports on test-labelled hosts require production provenance and control-total checks.

12 October: completed the ordered 28-state source pass and a deeper departmental-budget pass. 444 source responses / 324 distinct PDF files preserved; new candidate records stay private. Seven existing request threads checked: no new usable export or substantive response.
